description: Deterministic fixture for the Hub report pair: plan_report (plan_layout -> narrate) composing answer_batch through one batched `ask` call. Every stage's artifact is pinned so the compiler tests, the Rust host producers and both TypeScript dispatchers assert the same contract: placeholders carry no values, the call carries every slot and the preamble, the callee returns one tabular answer per slot as an array, a host may only narrow a callee result before the alias resolves, and the narrator preserves every materialised value while mapping refused or unanswerable slots to unavailable cells.

batch_answers.summary: Total revenue for fiscal 2025 was 1,284,500 USD across completed orders.

definition.sql: SELECT SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM revenue WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND status = 'completed'

batch_answers.summary: Revenue grew every quarter of fiscal 2025, from 290,000 USD in Q1 to 362,000 USD in Q4.

definition.sql: SELECT quarter, SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue FROM revenue WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND status = 'completed' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

batch_answers.summary: Northwind Traders led fiscal 2025 with 96,200 USD; the top five customers together brought in 410,550 USD.

definition.sql: SELECT customer_name AS customer, SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue FROM revenue WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

batch_answers.summary: Revenue rose in every quarter of fiscal 2025, from 290,000 USD in Q1 to 362,000 USD in Q4; Q4 contributed the most, 28% of the year's 1,284,500 USD.

definition.sql: SELECT quarter, SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue, SUM(total_revenue) / SUM(SUM(total_revenue)) OVER () AS share_of_year FROM revenue WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' AND status = 'completed' GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter

report.summary: Fiscal 2025 revenue from completed orders totalled 1,284,500 USD, building steadily from 290,000 USD in the first quarter to 362,000 USD in the fourth. Northwind Traders was the largest customer at 96,200 USD, followed by Blue Yonder Airlines and Contoso Ltd. The refund rate is unavailable because the semantic context defines no refund measure, and order-level detail is unavailable as individual-level data.
